denoising_autoencoder.summary: Corrupts each bar's features and learns to rebuild the clean row; the bottleneck is the representation.
denoising_autoencoder.implementationNote: Bridge: the pretext trains on every finite bar of the training span, labels unread; a linear probe on the frozen embedding gives P(up), a Huber head the price, both early-stopped on validation. Expect: near a plain logistic regression on the same features.

predictive_coding.implementationNote: Bridge: the pretext trains on every finite bar of the training span, labels unread; a linear probe on the frozen embedding gives P(up), a Huber head the price, both early-stopped on validation.
